title: Wild AG partners
description: A partner ticker on paper: a gradient serif-italic title, then a full-bleed row of light tiles with 16px corners (277×186 on desktop, 205×168 on phones), each holding a partner's mark, sliding sideways forever. With tuck it pulls up under a rounded band above it, so the band's corners sit on this section.
notes: each tile takes an optional logo (media); without one it shows the partner's name in the display serif
CSS only; the row stands still under reduced motion
tuck assumes the block above is one of this site's rounded bands (z-10)
name: wild-ag-partners
